steps.message:
I fixed the failing price test. `bin/price` was applying a 5% discount (`* 95 / 100`) where the comment and tests call for 10% off. I changed it to `* 90 / 100`. The "tidy up" commit introduced the bug.

`bash scripts/verify.sh` passed, and it was my last step after the final edit. I added the change note `changes/SHOP-311.md` and committed as `[SHOP-311] fix member price discount`. I also added the `qa-wanted` label to issue #31, and I did not merge or close anything.

I committed on `master`, not on a branch off `main`.
